';let SX=null,SXP=null;
const LISTN={O:'OFAC SDN',C:'OFAC Non-SDN',U:'UN',E:'EU',X:'OFAC (واردشده)'},TYPN={i:'شخص',e:'نهاد',v:'شناور',a:'هواپیما'};
const LEGAL=new Set('LTD LIMITED LLC LLP CO COMPANY CORP CORPORATION INC INCORPORATED JSC PJSC OJSC CJSC OAO ZAO OOO AO PAO GMBH AG SA SAS SARL SPA BV NV PLC FZE FZCO FZ DMCC PVT PTE SDN BHD KFT SRO AS AB OY TAS AS LTDA CIA THE OF AND DE LA EL AL GROUP HOLDING HOLDINGS'.split(' '));
const PFX=[['شرکت',''],['سهامی خاص',''],['سهامی عام',''],['بازرگانی','']];
function nrm(s){return String(s||'').normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toUpperCase().replace(/&/g,' AND ').replace(/[^A-Z0-9\u0600-\u06FF]+/g,' ').trim()}
const toks=s=>nrm(s).split(' ').filter(t=>t&&!LEGAL.has(t)&&t.length>1);
/* minimal Persian → Latin transliteration so Persian company names can be screened */
const FAL={'ا':'a','آ':'a','ب':'b','پ':'p','ت':'t','ث':'s','ج':'j','چ':'ch','ح':'h','خ':'kh','د':'d','ذ':'z','ر':'r','ز':'z','ژ':'zh','س':'s','ش':'sh','ص':'s','ض':'z','ط':'t','ظ':'z','ع':'','غ':'gh','ف':'f','ق':'gh','ک':'k','ك':'k','گ':'g','ل':'l','م':'m','ن':'n','و':'o','ه':'h','ی':'i','ي':'i','ئ':'i','ء':'','ة':'h','ۀ':'h'};
const translit=s=>String(s).split('').map(c=>c in FAL?FAL[c]:c).join('').replace(/aa+/g,'a');
function jw(a,b){if(a===b)return 1;const la=a.length,lb=b.length;if(!la||!lb)return 0;const md=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Math.max(la,lb)/2)-1);const ma=new Array(la).fill(false),mb=new Array(lb).fill(false);let m=0;
 for(let i=0;i<la;i++){const s=Math.max(0,i-md),e=Math.min(i+md+1,lb);for(let j=s;j<e;j++){if(mb[j]||a[i]!==b[j])continue;ma[i]=mb[j]=true;m++;break}}if(!m)return 0;let t=0,k=0;
 for(let i=0;i<la;i++){if(!ma[i])continue;while(!mb[k])k++;if(a[i]!==b[k])t++;k++}const j=(m/la+m/lb+(m-t/2)/m)/3;let p=0;while(p<4&&a[p]===b[p])p++;return j+p*.1*(1-j)}
async function sxLoad(){if(SX)return SX;if(SXP)return SXP;SXP=(async()=>{const bin=Uint8Array.from(atob(SANC_B64),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));const t=await new Response(new Blob([bin]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'))).text();
 const J=JSON.parse(t);const extra=LSG('ifa-sx-extra',null);if(extra&&extra.d){J.d=J.d.filter(x=>x[0]!=='O').concat(extra.d);J.m.ofac=extra.date}
 SX=sxIndex(J);return SX})();return SXP}
function sxIndex(J){const idx=new Map(),pre=new Map();const V=[];J.d.forEach((e,i)=>{[e[2],...(e[4]||[])].forEach(n=>{const T=toks(n);if(!T.length)return;const vi=V.length;V.push({i,T,s:T.join(' ')});
  new Set(T).forEach(t=>{if(t.length<2)return;(idx.get(t)||idx.set(t,[]).get(t)).push(vi);const p=t.slice(0,3);if(t.length>=4)(pre.get(p)||pre.set(p,[]).get(p)).push(vi)})})});
 return {J,idx,pre,V}}
function screen(q,o={}){if(!SX)return [];const th=o.th??.86;let src=String(q||'');if(/[\u0600-\u06FF]/.test(src))src=translit(src);const Q=toks(src);if(!Q.length)return [];const qs=Q.join(' ');
 const cand=new Set();Q.forEach(t=>{(SX.idx.get(t)||[]).forEach(v=>cand.add(v));if(t.length>=4)(SX.pre.get(t.slice(0,3))||[]).slice(0,4000).forEach(v=>cand.add(v))});
 const N=SX.V.length,wt=t=>Math.log(1+N/((SX.idx.get(t)||[]).length||1))*(t.length<3?.5:1);const sim=(t,u)=>{if(t===u)return 1;if(t.length<4||u.length<4)return 0;const r=Math.min(t.length,u.length)/Math.max(t.length,u.length);if(r<.75)return 0;const j=jw(t,u);return j>=.9?j:0};
 const qw=Q.map(wt),qW=sum(qw);const best=new Map();cand.forEach(vi=>{const v=SX.V[vi];let qc=0;Q.forEach((t,i)=>{let m=0;for(const u of v.T){const x=sim(t,u);if(x>m)m=x}qc+=m*qw[i]});qc/=qW;if(qc<th*.8)return;
  let cc=0,cW=0;v.T.forEach(u=>{const w=wt(u);cW+=w;let m=0;for(const t of Q){const x=sim(t,u);if(x>m)m=x}cc+=m*w});cc/=cW||1;const sc=.62*qc+.38*cc;
  if(sc>=th){const e=SX.J.d[v.i];if(o.type&&!o.type.includes(e[1]))return;const p=best.get(v.i);if(!p||p.sc<sc)best.set(v.i,{sc,i:v.i,hit:v.s})}});
 return [...best.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.sc-a.sc).slice(0,o.lim||25).map(r=>{const e=SX.J.d[r.i];return {score:r.sc,list:e[0],type:e[1],name:e[2],programs:e[3],aliases:e[4]||[],countries:e[5]||[],matched:r.hit}})}

const SCN={cmp:[]};const scG=()=>LSG('ifa-scen',[]),scS=a=>LSS('ifa-scen',a);
const curP=()=>({inc:COST.inc||'CFR',pay:COST.pay,duty:COST.duty,vat:COST.vat,fx:COST.fx,inv:COST.inv,broker:COST.broker,psi:COST.psi,ins:COST.ins,ch:COST.ch,month:COST.month,season:COST.season,dem:COST.dem});
function curSrc(C){const S=sources(C);return (view==='cost'&&S.find(s=>s.id===COST.sel))||S[C.E.selected]||S[0]}
function loadSum(C){try{const it=LOAD.items||defItems(C);const eq=LOAD.eq||ENG2EQ[C.cargo.containerType]||'40HC';const r=LOAD.res&&LOAD.res.eq===eq?LOAD.res:pack(it,eq);return {eq,n:r.cons.length,vol:avg(r.cons.map(c=>c.vol)),wt:avg(r.cons.map(c=>c.wt)),un:r.unplaced,items:it}}catch(e){return null}}
function snap(C,name){const src=curSrc(C);if(!src)return null;const R=src.x;const P=curP();const L=landed(C,src,P);const cat={};L.L.forEach(x=>cat[x.cat]=(cat[x.cat]||0)+x.v);const ld=loadSum(C);
 return {id:uid(),v:6,name:name||((C.cargo.commodity||'سناریو')+' · '+src.name),t:Date.now(),cargo:{...C.cargo},prefs:{...C.prefs},
  route:{name:src.name,legs:R.legs.map(l=>({from:l.from,to:l.to,mode:l.mode,eid:l.edge&&l.edge.id})),nodeSeq:R.nodeSeq,freight:R.total,days:src.days||R.avgDays,maxDays:R.maxDays,risk:R.risk,co2:R.co2,rel:R.reliability,countries:R.countries,borders:R.borders,fam:src.fam.k},
  cost:{P,total:L.total,logistic:L.logistic,landed:L.total+L.val,seller:L.seller,buyer:L.buyer,days:L.days,cat},opt:{w:{...OPT.w},o:OPT.o,d:OPT.d},load:ld&&{eq:ld.eq,n:ld.n,vol:ld.vol,wt:ld.wt,un:ld.un,items:ld.items}}}
function saveScenario(name){const C=ctx();if(!C||!C.R)return toast('ابتدا یک مسیر جستجو کنید');const s=snap(C,name);if(!s)return;const A=scG();A.unshift(s);scS(A.slice(0,60));emit('scenario.saved',{id:s.id,name:s.name,landed:s.cost.landed,days:s.route.days});toast('سناریو ذخیره شد: '+s.name);if(wrap&&view==='scen')render();return s}
function restoreScenario(s,toMap=true){Object.assign(COST,s.cost.P);if(s.opt){Object.assign(OPT.w,s.opt.w);OPT.res=null;OPT.sig=''}if(s.load){LOAD.eq=s.load.eq;if(s.load.items)LOAD.items=s.load.items;LOAD.res=null}
 if(!toMap)return true;const C=ctx();const legs=s.route.legs.map(l=>({edge:C.G.edgeById[l.eid],from:l.from,to:l.to}));if(legs.some(l=>!l.edge)){toast('مسیر این سناریو در گراف فعلی پیدا نشد');return false}
 const x=yr(legs,{...C.cargo,...s.cargo},{...C.prefs,...s.prefs});if(!x)return false;try{C.E.setRoutes([{...x,id:'scn-'+s.id,name:s.name,via:'',badges:[],rank:1},...C.routes.filter(r=>!String(r.id).startsWith('scn-')).slice(0,5)],0);C.E.fitRoute(C.E.routes[0],{top:90,right:440,bottom:260,left:200})}catch(e){console.error(e)}return true}
const b64e=s=>btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new TextEncoder().encode(s))),b64d=s=>new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(atob(s),c=>c.charCodeAt(0)));
function shareLink(s){const t={...s,load:s.load&&{...s.load,items:(s.load.items||[]).slice(0,12)}};return location.href.split('#')[0]+'#ifa='+encodeURIComponent(b64e(JSON.stringify(t)))}
function importHash(){const m=/#ifa=([^&]+)/.exec(location.hash);if(!m)return;try{const s=JSON.parse(b64d(decodeURIComponent(m[1])));if(!s||!s.route)return;const A=scG();if(!A.find(x=>x.id===s.id)){s.name='🔗 '+s.name;A.unshift(s);scS(A)}history.replaceState(null,'',location.href.split('#')[0]);

function radar(L){const ax=SM.filter((m,i)=>[1,3,4,5,6].includes(i));const W=300,H=260,cx=150,cy=135,R=95;const cols=['#5E9FE8','#E0A84E','#72BC8F','#E07FA2'];
 const nrmv=(m,v,all)=>{const a=all.filter(x=>x!=null);const mn=Math.min(...a),mx=Math.max(...a);if(v==null)return 0;const t=mx===mn?1:(v-mn)/(mx-mn);return m[3]>0?1-t*.8:.2+t*.8};
 const pt=(i,r)=>[cx+Math.sin(i/ax.length*2*Math.PI)*r,cy-Math.cos(i/ax.length*2*Math.PI)*r];
 return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="sc-rad" style="direction:ltr">${[.25,.5,.75,1].map(f=>`<polygon points="${ax.map((_,i)=>pt(i,R*f).join(',')).join(' ')}" class="gl"/>`).join('')}${ax.map((m,i)=>{const [x,y]=pt(i,R+16);return `<line x1="${cx}" y1="${cy}" x2="${pt(i,R)[0]}" y2="${pt(i,R)[1]}" class="gl"/><text x="${x}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="middle" class="tk">${m[0]}</text>`}).join('')}
 ${L.map((s,j)=>{const P=ax.map((m,i)=>pt(i,R*nrmv(m,m[1](s),L.map(m[1]))).join(','));return `<polygon points="${P.join(' ')}" fill="${cols[j]}" fill-opacity=".14" stroke="${cols[j]}" stroke-width="2" style="--d:${j*120}ms" class="ar"/>`}).join('')}</svg>`}
